title: Mihrimah Sultan Mosque, Edirnekapı

buildingCutout.basis: The named mosque and madrasa enclosure replaces the procedural building around its open courtyard.

terrainReference.basis: Original courtyard elevation on the raised Edirnekapı terrace.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap mapped Edirnekapı relation 7318379 and the complete open court.
mapIdentity.scope: Named OpenStreetMap relation 7318379 has an 18-point outer footprint and a four-point open court, fixing the terrace extent and direction. Gurlitt’s published plan identifies the single large dome flanked by three bays per side, the seven central porch bays, fountain and court cells.

note: Columbia documents a 20 m dome diameter and a 37 m height. The Istanbul heritage directorate describes the cut stone windowed tympana and the late single minaret. The exact cleared 1912 photo shows alternating arch bands and column recesses, and Gurlitt’s section shows dome, drum and aperture proportions.
